title: SCULTURA ENDURANCE 4000
notes: Current official global page supports a CF3 II carbon frame, Shimano 105 R7100 mechanical 12-speed build, EXPERT SLIII wheels, Maxxis Re-Fuse 32 mm tires, 35 mm maximum clearance or 32 mm with fenders, sizes and geometry. Those facts describe a newer generation than the public community report's R7000 11-speed, Expert SL and Detonator build, so the records are not merged.
